description: This file defines a 'Parser' struct within the 'cuttlefish' namespace, which includes static methods and member variables related to parsing command-line flags or arguments for a process restarter component. It also includes licensing information and necessary includes.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: A struct that encapsulates parsing logic and configuration flags for process restart behavior, including flags for ignoring signals, handling dump, kill, exit failure, and an exit code, along with a first-time argument.

methods.name: ConsumeAndParse
methods.description: A static method that consumes and parses a vector of strings to produce a Result containing a Parser instance.
